title: Where the thinking came from
subtitle: The influences behind the book, as claims you can check, and where each one lands. 10 panels.
book_version: v1.0.0 is the only official version; the second edition is in release candidates (rc1 and rc2 frozen)
by: gen-z.journalist, 18 October 2026, from the review of influences.sgit.ai
rule: Every line the Guide says, and every quote card, is from the article 'Where the thinking came from', word for word; the build checks it. Real people appear as quote cards and dates, never as cast members.
